title: Names
text: ’ll cover principles implemented grp_fname()

what: 1. Machine readable: file names should be useful to program with, i.e., easy to search and filter, avoid reliance on case, accented characters, white space, etc.
title: Names
text: grp_fname() convert names lower kebab-case add date prefix.
code: grp_fname("My File.txt") ✔ '2023-04-09_my-file.txt' is copied to the clipboard!

what: 2. Human readable: File names should be named similar to URLs. Specifically, the portion of the URL that “is usually the end part of the URL (specifically of the path / pathinfo part), which can be interpreted as the name of the resource, similar to the basename in a filename or the title of a page” is referred to as the slug for brief description of file contents).
title: Names
text: grp_fname() removes special characters (keeps words):

what: 3. Easily sorted/ordered: If a logical order for the files in a directory exists, the filenames should include a numeric prefix that contains the inherent order, with sufficient left-side padding (i.e., 01-import.R, 02-wrangle.R, 03-model.R, etc.).
title: Names
text: grp_fname() conserves numeric prefixes (appends date prefix):
code: grp_fname("01-report.xlsx") ✔ '2023-04-09_01-report.xlsx' is copied to the clipboard!

title: Folder paths
text: operating system folder structure refers files directories (.e. folders) organized computer’s hard drive. Folder structures can vary depending specific operating system used. However, operating systems basic design, including hierarchical tree-like arrangement similar common folders: Users/usr: user-level programs, utilities, libraries, documentation Library/lib: shared library files used applications bin: holds necessary system binary files programs etc: contains system configuration files Home/home: user-specific files directories computer’s operating system folder structure organized provide logical predictable way storing accessing folders files computer. Applications like Windows Explorer Finder present computer’s folder file structure display can navigate mouse cursor, behind scenes ’re accessing system paths (locations).

title: Folder paths
text: Folder paths typically consist series names indicate hierarchical structure folder system, separated forward slash ("/") backslash ("\") (depending operating system). Unix-based systems (like macOS Linux), topmost (root) folder usually represented forward slash (/). ’s file path, may also include file’s extension. example, Linux macOS file path might look like : usr/home/docs/file.txt system: "usr" holds user-related programs, utilities, libraries "home" user-specific files folders "docs" sub-folder within user’s home folder, "file.txt" name extension file Windows systems, root folder assigned ‘drive letter’ followed backslash (.e, C:\). example Windows file path might look like : C:\Users\Username\Documents\file.txt case: "C:" represents computer’s hard drive "Users" folder name "Username" user account folder "Documents" sub-folder within user’s home folder, "file.txt" name extension file can see two examples , file paths provide exact location file folder directory structure computer’s file system.

title: gerp 3.0.0
text: functions renamed ger_ prefix grp_ (e.g., ger_create() now grp_create()). grp_sect() drops <(+_+)> decoration gains level (# level 1, ## level 2, etc.). Removed grp_proj(). Use grp_create() instead. grp_create(folder, name) now grp_create(path, open). grp_setup(), grp_code(), grp_data(), grp_dev(), grp_report() take path (folder_name) never overwrite existing files. grp_code(header) now grp_code(roxygen). grp_path(...) now grp_path(path, type, tree); type = "rel" returns path relative working directory. grp_root() defaults tree = FALSE returns root path. grp_batch_rename() defaults "modification" date uses grp_fname() naming rules. grp_name() replaces every symbol (just first) separates abbreviations underscores.

title: gerp 3.0.0
text: Works RStudio Positron. grp_root() finds projects .Rproj file, DESCRIPTION, .git, .. grp_name() grp_fname() vectorized, return result, gain clip (date grp_fname()). grp_batch_rename() gains dry_run, skips already dated files, returns old new paths. Project templates ship inst/templates/ (downloads required).

title: gerp 3.0.0
text: Dependencies reduced cli, clipr, fs, rprojroot, rstudioapi. Added testthat tests R CMD check workflow.
